name: NVIDIA V100 SXM2 32GB
memory_bandwidth_basis: 900 GB/s as published for V100 SXM2 32GB (nv-v100-datasheet). Consistent with HBM2 at 1.95Gbps-class data rate x 4096-bit: 4096/8 x 1.95e9 x 2(hdr) is not exactly the quoted figure, so treat the datasheet number as authoritative and the bus width as the 4096-bit Volta HBM2 interface.
notes: Tesla-generation part. NVIDIA quotes 125 TFLOPS 'Tensor Performance' for SXM2 (FP16, dense - the datasheet has no sparsity notation, and Volta Tensor Cores have no 2:4 sparse path). PCIe V100 32GB is the same silicon at 14 TFLOPS FP32 / 112 TFLOPS FP16 tensor / 900 GB/s / 250W but is a different form factor and power envelope. Bus-width figure of 4096-bit is the standard Volta HBM2 width and is NOT stated in this datasheet (the sheet omits it) - treat it as lower-confidence than the bandwidth number. The one 'other' row here is FP64 (7.8 TFLOPS, dense) - the schema's precision enum has no fp64 member, so it is filed under 'other'.
